mcqs.learning_point: Group digits according to the international system
mcqs.question: Which of the following numbers is correctly written using the international place‑value grouping (thousands, millions, etc.)?
mcqs.explanation: In the international system digits are grouped in threes from the right: ones‑hundreds‑thousands, then millions, billions, etc. 12,345,678 follows this pattern (12 million, 345 thousand, 678). The other options break the grouping incorrectly.

mcqs.learning_point: Read numbers using international place-value names
mcqs.question: How is the number 5,678,901 read in words according to the international place‑value system?

options.A: Five million six hundred seventy‑eight thousand nine hundred one
options.B: Five hundred sixty‑seven thousand eight hundred ninety one
options.C: Fifty‑six lakh seven thousand nine hundred one
options.D: Five million six hundred seventy‑eight thousand ninety one

mcqs.answer: Five million six hundred seventy‑eight thousand nine hundred one
mcqs.explanation: The number 5,678,901 consists of 5 millions, 678 thousands and 901 units. Hence it is read as "Five million six hundred seventy‑eight thousand nine hundred one". Options B, C and D either misplace the commas or use a different numbering system.

mcqs.learning_point: Write numbers using international comma placement
mcqs.question: Write the number 987654321 using the correct international comma placement.
mcqs.explanation: Starting from the right, place a comma after every three digits: 987,654,321. The other options break the three‑digit grouping rule.

mcqs.learning_point: Determine place value in the international system
mcqs.question: In the number 3,452,789, what is the place value of the digit 5?
mcqs.explanation: Reading from left: 3 million, 4 hundred thousand, 5 ten thousand, 2 thousand, 7 hundred, 8 tens, 9 ones. Therefore the digit 5 occupies the ten‑thousands place. The other options refer to different positions.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes the ones, tens and hundreds places?

options.A: The ones place represents groups of ten.
options.B: The tens place is ten times the value of the ones place.
options.C: The hundreds place is ten times the value of the tens place.
options.D: Both B and C are correct.

mcqs.answer: Both B and C are correct.
mcqs.explanation: The ones place holds single units. The tens place holds values ten times larger than the ones place, and the hundreds place holds values ten times larger than the tens place. Option A is false because the ones place holds single units, not groups of ten.

mcqs.question: The number 7,250,000 contains the digit 7 in which place‑value group?
mcqs.explanation: 7,250,000 reads as seven million two hundred fifty thousand. The leading digit 7 is in the millions group. The other options refer to lower or higher groups.

mcqs.learning_point: Group digits according to the international system
mcqs.question: Which of the following shows the correct grouping of the number 45,678,912 according to the international system?
mcqs.explanation: The international system groups digits in sets of three from the right: 45 million, 678 thousand, 912. Option A follows this rule. All other options break the three‑digit grouping.

mcqs.learning_point: Read numbers using international place-value names
mcqs.question: A child sees the sign "2,034,567" on a road billboard. How should the child read this number aloud?

options.A: Two million thirty‑four thousand five hundred sixty‑seven
options.B: Two thousand thirty‑four hundred fifty‑six seven
options.C: Twenty‑three lakh forty‑three thousand five hundred sixty‑seven
options.D: Two million three hundred forty‑five thousand six hundred seventy

mcqs.answer: Two million thirty‑four thousand five hundred sixty‑seven
mcqs.explanation: The number 2,034,567 is read as "two million thirty‑four thousand five hundred sixty‑seven" in the international system. Option B mixes place values, C uses the Indian system, and D misstates the digits.
